intro.title: Every Service You Need to Build, Launch and Grow Online
paragraphs: Most businesses end up juggling a web designer, an app agency, a freelancer for integrations and someone else for hosting. Every handoff adds delay, cost and finger-pointing. We bring all of it under one roof: strategy, UI/UX design, software development, testing, cloud and long-term support, delivered by one senior team that stays accountable from start to finish.

Our IT services cover four areas. Software development for custom, enterprise, SaaS, web and mobile applications. Ready-to-customise business software such as CRM, inventory, complaint management and IT asset tracking. Web design and branding for websites, landing pages and brand identity. And cloud, AI, integration, QA and maintenance services that keep everything running smoothly.

Not sure where to start? Use the guide below to find the right service, browse <work>our case studies</work>, or <contact>talk to a senior engineer</contact> for a free consultation and honest advice.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Services
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers before you get in touch.

items.a: We offer software development (custom, enterprise, web, mobile and SaaS), business software such as CRM, ecommerce, inventory, complaint and IT asset management, web design and branding, and cloud, DevOps, AI automation, API integration, QA testing and maintenance services.

items.q: How do I know which service I need?
items.a: Start with your goal, such as getting more enquiries, selling online or automating work. Use the guide on this page, or book a free consultation and a senior engineer will recommend the right approach, even if it is simpler than you expected.

items.q: Can one team handle design, development and support?
items.a: Yes. Our team covers UI/UX design, frontend and backend development, mobile apps, testing, cloud and ongoing maintenance, so you work with one accountable partner from idea to long after launch.

items.q: How much do your services cost?
items.a: It depends on the service and scope. Websites start from a few hundred dollars, business software and apps from a few thousand, and larger platforms are quoted after discovery. Every service page shows typical price ranges, and you get a fixed, itemised quote after a free consultation.

items.q: Do you work with startups and small businesses?
items.a: Yes. We help startups launch MVPs quickly and offer affordable packages for small businesses, as well as delivering larger projects for enterprises.

items.q: What engagement models do you offer?
items.a: Fixed-price projects, dedicated teams, staff augmentation and monthly managed services such as maintenance, DevOps and QA as a service.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside India?
items.a: Yes. We are a remote-first team working with clients across India and worldwide, with calls scheduled in your time zone.

items.q: Will I own the code and designs?
items.a: Yes. You own 100% of the source code, designs and intellectual property, and we sign an NDA before you share project details.
